scope: Native tuple_to_list/1 with owned moving roots and precharged cons construction.
adaptations: Require an owned tuple or raise badarg. Empty tuples return NIL without allocation or collection. For positive arity, reserve two words per element plus existing heap credit, precharge construction, reload the tuple after GC, and construct the proper list backwards in native order.

Copy element references, not their values or backing; the source tuple remains unchanged. Publish the final heap top only after all infallible cons writes. Preserve work/quota/OOM distinctions and the runtime heap-cap boundary without claiming every natively valid tuple can be converted under finite limits.

Compiled fixtures and an independent OTP oracle cover empty/mixed/repeated elements, order, binary values and badarg. Component tests retain the source in an explicit moving root and prove element aliasing, source preservation, heap/refcounted binary behavior, forced GC, allocation/quota/work prefixes, primitive heap credit and exact final balance. Shared-worker tests cover exact/one-below thresholds, reuse, peer survival and reclamation.
